name: zclipalt_set_target_rect
description: zClipAlt::SetTargetRect configures the alternate clip target rectangle and remap scale/bias globals.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x479f90 validates gClipRect_Alt setup, remap offset and scale computation from source and target rectangles, replicate-mode primary-origin halving, and bias computation with or without primary-origin contribution.
The native smoke verifies target clip fields, remap offsets/scales, normal bias, and replicate/origin-adjusted bias.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x479f90 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zClipAlt/zModel geometry pass.
